## What's New

- Comment editor with Discord markdown: **bold**, *italic*, underline, strikethrough, spoiler, and code.
- Emoji picker with server custom emojis (`<:name:id>`) and common Unicode emojis.
- Optional **image attachment** per map (max 1, PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF up to 8MB) — posted with the review on Discord.
- **Votecrew** can no longer create forum discussions automatically (discussions open after review approval).
